You hold exactly 12 eyes of ender. Before you reach the portal room you will throw eyes 3 more times (one eye per throw) to locate the stronghold, and pick up every eye that survives.

Current state (JSON):
{
 "dimension": "overworld",
 "position": null,
 "inventory": {
  "ender_eye": 12
 },
 "known_locations": {},
 "world": {},
 "elapsed_s": null
}

(1) What is the expected number of eyes you lose over the 3 throws? (2) What is the probability that none of the 3 thrown eyes breaks? Give decimals.

{"expected_eyes_lost": <number>, "p_no_eye_lost": <number>}
